title: Give me a screenshot of the index page.

messages.content: Give me a screenshot of the index page.

Here's the index page (anonymous view) at **3840×2160** (1920×1080 @2x retina), full-page.

![CRS index — sign-in page, dark theme](crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png)

## What it shows
- **Sign-in gate** — the index route for a logged-out visitor is the login screen: **CRS logo** + "Casino Reporting Suite" wordmark, then a centered **Sign in** card with Email and Password fields, a "Forgot password?" link, and a **Sign in** button.
- **Dark theme**, single centered card on a near-black (`#181818`) background; footer legal line ("Terms & Privacy Policy") and a green **"All systems operational"** status pill at the bottom (wired to the crs.statuspage.io embed).
- Layout is clean and correctly centered at desktop width — no overflow or broken elements.

## Notes
- This is the **anonymous** view. To see the actual authenticated dashboard/home, I'd capture it as a logged-in test user (`buildprint screenshot <testuser-email> "/"`). Say the word and I'll grab that, plus a light-theme and/or mobile version.
- Saved to `crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png`.

messages.content:
I hit a genuine blocker getting an authenticated screenshot of User Management — worth flagging rather than continuing to guess.

## What happened
- User Management lives inside the SPA "app" page, reached via `option.module = user_mgmt` (not a separate Bubble page) — confirmed in `pages/bTpoF/elements/bTNrp0/bVFFp/element.json`.
- `buildprint login vladlen.biz@gmail.com` (your own account — it has `menu_users`/`menu_user_permissions`) fails to auto-install cookies on this Windows setup (`'<userid>' is not recognized as an internal or external command` — looks like a bug in buildprint's cookie-install shell-out on Windows).
- I manually applied the cookie commands it printed (`agent-browser cookies set ...`, adjusted `--domain/--path` → `--url` since the former errored with "Invalid cookie fields"), including a full `cookies clear` to rule out a stale anonymous-session cookie collision. Still landed back on the Sign-in screen every time.
- The `buildprint screenshot <email> "<path>"` command (the documented alternative) hung indefinitely in the background and never produced output; I killed it after ~7 minutes rather than let it hang further.

## Where I left off
I have a clean, authenticated-looking cookie set installed in the Agent Browser session, but the app still renders the login form — so either the session cookie itself is being rejected server-side (e.g. IP/basic-auth mismatch) or this login screen doesn't auto-redirect an already-authenticated session and instead requires an explicit action.

## What I need from you
- Do you have a **test user password** I could use to actually submit the sign-in form (more reliable than cookie injection)? or
- Want me to keep retrying the `buildprint login`/cookie route, or should I flag this to you as a CLI bug to fix separately?

I don't want to keep spinning on the same failing approach — let me know which way you'd like to go.
